title: Dynamic sensorimotor patterns explain the comparative gaps

statements.text: Perceptual experience is a skillful activity partly constituted by practical knowledge of dynamic sensorimotor patterns. These patterns make intelligible why an experience is like seeing rather than hearing, which neural correlates do not, and they predict where cortex defers to new input.

sources.quote: According to the dynamic sensorimotor view, perceptual experience is a skillful activity, in part constituted by such practical know-how.
Sensorimotor contingencies are more promising in respect of intermodal comparative explanatory gaps than neural correlates of consciousness.
